title: Find canonical ontology term using VFB SOLR to query synonyms — vfb_synonym_query
text: query character vector containing one queries - see details. Wildcards (?*) can used, similar meaning use shell. Queries case insensitive. exact Whether exact match (.e. query must match whole string, default) allow partial matches synonyms. See Query details examples. quote Whether quote query individual terms must matched order given term query. default quote=NA quote exact=TRUE query contain wildcards. See Query details Examples. searchfields Character vector specifying fields search. default searches synonyms canonical term label (since canonical term included synonym list). fields fields return (defaults 'short_form label synonym'). Setting fields="" implies fields (note results may fields - see discussion details) verbose Whether print messages screen. ... Additional arguments passed pbsapply multiple input queries eventually vfb_solr_query. can use e.g. set number returned rows.

title: Find canonical ontology term using VFB SOLR to query synonyms — vfb_synonym_query
text: data.frame containing one result rows, ordered according   solr result score, attributes

title: Find canonical ontology term using VFB SOLR to query synonyms — vfb_synonym_query
text: Note data.frame returned may contain list   synonym column likely multiple synonyms given   query. x length > 1 .e. multiple query terms, multiple calls   vfb_solr_query wrapped   pbsapply statement. can pass arguments   sapply ... simplify=FALSE wish.   default return value matrix rows can index   field name columns can index queries. However form   guaranteed ask fields present   results. Note also

title: Find canonical ontology term using VFB SOLR to query synonyms — vfb_synonym_query
text: exact quote arguments   profound effect SOLR carries searches. Setting arguments   FALSE gives least specific search may want   find results initial query using default values. general SOLR break text fields like synonym separate   tokens based whitespace, hyphens etc, value : inter-antennal lobe tract map onto 4 tokens. inter antennal lobe tract means search query "inter antennal lobe tract",   exact=F successful (note missing hyphen). exact=TRUE, values tokenised query must   match whole field. quote argument modifies query. default query   tokenised just described fields database, tokens can   matched order one token must match (.e.   ORed together).  quote=TRUE, query must match   order given (achieved wrapping double quotes   passing SOLR). example vfb_synonym_query("antennal lobe tract", exact=F, quote=T) returns 2 results time writing whereas vfb_synonym_query("antennal lobe tract", exact=F, quote=F) returns 194 results. See   https://github.com/EBISPOT/OLS/blob/master/ols-solr/src/main/solr-conf/ontology/conf/schema.xml    definition synonym_s exact match field.

text: Virtual Fly Brain project provides website virtualflybrain.org containing neuroanatomical data fruit fly, Drosophila melanogaster, curated published journal articles bulk image data. package enables queries experimental (time writing) API.

title: Programmatic Access to the virtualflybrain.org website — vfbr-package
text: vfb_solr_query Allows query VFB's SOLR end  point. gives programmatic access great majority searches  can perform interactively VFB website. vfb_neo4j_query Allows query VFB's Neo4J end  point. gives programmatic access many sophisticated searches  based VFB ontology, including searches may easily  accessible via website. vfb_synonym_query higher level function allows  search canonical terms synonyms matching given query.

title: Programmatic Access to the virtualflybrain.org website — vfbr-package
text: following options can set specify default  behaviour. set sensible defaults package startup, unless  previously set value (e.g. Rprofile).  vfbr.server URL main VFB server vfbr.server.neo4j URL Neo4J graph database queries vfbr.server.solr URL SOLR queries vfbr.server.owl URL OWL ontology queries vfbr.server.gepetto URL VFB's gepetto server 3D visualisation (see vfb_3dbrowser_url.) vfbr.server.r URL opencpu/R queries - users moment vfbr.stack.gmr_url URL containing listing registered GMR Gal4 confocal stacks. See gmr_stack_urls vfbr.stack.downloads Location downloaded stacks. See download_gmr_stacks
